# transport

`device_notifier`, `hid_device`, `windows_hid_device`, and `xinput_module` form the Windows controller-transport layer for HID discovery, asynchronous reports, device-change notifications, and dynamically loaded XInput APIs.

## Contents

### HID transport

- [hid.hpp](./hid.hpp) defines `hid_device`, `hid_enumeration_entry`, `hid_attributes`, `classify_link`, `enumerate`, and `open`.
- [hid.cpp](./hid.cpp) implements `windows_hid_device`, HID enumeration, capability validation, overlapped I/O, feature reports, and read-only fallback.

### Device notification

- [device-notify.hpp](./device-notify.hpp) defines non-copyable `device_notifier`, `consume`, `run`, `pending_`, and `window_`.
- [device-notify.cpp](./device-notify.cpp) implements the `WM_DEVICECHANGE` message-only window, HID registration, worker-thread message pumping, and polling fallback.

### XInput transport

- [xinput-module.hpp](./xinput-module.hpp) defines non-copyable `xinput_module`, runtime status queries, and safe forwarding for `get_state`, `get_capabilities`, and `set_state`.
- [xinput-module.cpp](./xinput-module.cpp) implements ordered XInput DLL probing, function-pointer resolution, guide-button detection, reporting, and teardown.

## Architecture / Data Flow

`enumerate` discovers present HID interfaces, `classify_link` validates report framing, and `open` creates a `windows_hid_device` after re-querying `HidD_GetAttributes` and `query_caps`.

`device_notifier::run` converts `WM_DEVICECHANGE` events into the atomic `pending_` flag, while `device_notifier::consume` lets discovery reconcile devices or use polling.

`windows_hid_device::issue_read` starts overlapped `ReadFile` operations, `windows_hid_device::read` consumes completed reports, and `windows_hid_device::write`, `get_feature`, and `set_feature` submit output or feature transfers.

`xinput_module::load` probes `variants`, resolves mandatory entry points, optionally resolves ordinal `100`, and forwards controller calls through `get_state_`, `get_state_ex_`, `get_capabilities_`, and `set_state_`.

## API Surface

`hid_device::read` returns `optional<size_t>`, with `size_t(0)` for an in-flight read and `nullopt` for invalid or failed transport state.

`hid_device::write` and `hid_device::set_feature` require writable access, while `hid_device::get_feature` remains available when `feature_report_length()` is satisfied.

`classify_link` maps `64` to `connection::usb`, `78` to `connection::bluetooth`, and all other lengths to `connection::unknown`.

`xinput_module::loaded`, `xinput_module::dll_name`, and `xinput_module::has_guide_button` expose runtime-loading state without exposing `HMODULE` ownership.

## Behavioral Contracts

- `max_report_size` equals `128`, bounding `windows_hid_device::buf_`, `input_length_`, and `feature_length_`.
- `usb_input_report_length` equals `64`; `bluetooth_input_report_length` equals `78`.
- `window_class` equals `L"gamepad_controller_devnotify"`.
- `device_notifier::window_proc` handles `WM_DEVICECHANGE`, `WM_CLOSE`, and `WM_DESTROY`.
- `DBT_DEVICEARRIVAL` and `DBT_DEVICEREMOVECOMPLETE` set `pending_` with `std::memory_order_release`.
- `pending_.exchange(false, std::memory_order_acquire)` clears each notification after `consume`.
- `variants` probes `"xinput1_4.dll"`, `"xinput1_3.dll"`, and `"xinput9_1_0.dll"` in that order.
- `get_state_ex_` resolves ordinal `100`; missing `get_state_ex_` disables guide-button decoding without rejecting the DLL.
- `ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED` is returned by unavailable `get_state`, `get_capabilities`, and `set_state` entry points.

## Failure Contracts

`device_notifier::run` reports `"device-change window class registration failed; discovery will poll"`, `"device-change window creation failed; discovery will poll"`, and `"HID device-change registration failed; discovery will poll"` through `ctx.report`.

`enumerate` reports `"unable to enumerate HID device interfaces"` for `SetupDiGetClassDevsW` failure and reports recognized controllers with unsupported report lengths through `errc::ambiguous_identity`.

`open` reports `"unable to open a HID device interface"`, `"opened HID device does not answer its capabilities"`, and `"opened HID device is not a controller we can decode"` for activation failures.

`xinput_module::load` reports `"no XInput runtime could be loaded; XInput controllers will not be available"` when all `variants` fail.

## File Relationships

`hid.cpp` implements the abstract `hid_device` contract from `hid.hpp`, while `types.hpp`, `utility.hpp`, `context.hpp`, `id.hpp`, and `identity.hpp` supply transport-facing types.

`device-notify.cpp` implements lifecycle and Windows callbacks declared by `device-notify.hpp`, with `pending_` connecting the notifier thread to discovery polling.

`xinput-module.cpp` implements the ABI and ownership contract declared by `xinput-module.hpp`, with `context`, `severity`, `facility`, and `errc` controlling diagnostics.

`connection::usb` and `connection::bluetooth` describe report framing and layout; `classify_link` does not guarantee the physical bus.
